meaning.text_en:
WANDS. SIX.

A laurelled horseman bears one staff adorned with a laurel crown;
footmen with staves are at his side. _Divinatory Meanings_: The card has
been so designed that it can cover several significations; on the
surface, it is a victor triumphing, but it is also great news, such as
might be carried in state by the King's courier; it is expectation
crowned with its own desire, the crown of hope, and so forth.
_Reversed_: Apprehension, fear, as of a victorious enemy at the gate;
treachery, disloyalty, as of gates being opened to the enemy; also
indefinite delay.

upright.summary_zh: 勇气、辩论、谈判、竞争及有利位置带来的成功。
upright.text_en: It is a card of valor, for, on the surface, six are attacking one, who has, however, the vantage position. On the intellectual plane, it signifies discussion, wordy strife; in business--negotiations, war of trade, barter, competition. It is further a card of success, for the combatant is on the top and his enemies may be unable to reach him.

reversed.summary_zh: 困惑、窘迫、焦虑，并提醒避免优柔寡断。
reversed.text_en: Perplexity, embarrassments, anxiety. It is also a caution against indecision.

symbolism.summary_zh: 人物立在高处，以一根权杖面对下方六根权杖。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 选择真正值得维护的立场，用清楚理由表达它。
editorial.reversed_zh: 先整理最重要的争点，减少同时应对过多问题的压力。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你最需要守住的是哪一个原则？
editorial.caution_zh: 维护立场不等于必须把所有人视为敌人。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
WANDS. SEVEN.

A young man on a craggy eminence brandishing a staff; six other staves
are raised towards him from below. _Divinatory Meanings_: It is a card
of valor, for, on the surface, six are attacking one, who has, however,
the vantage position. On the intellectual plane, it signifies
discussion, wordy strife; in business--negotiations, war of trade,
barter, competition. It is further a card of success, for the combatant
is on the top and his enemies may be unable to reach him. _Reversed_:
Perplexity, embarrassments, anxiety. It is also a caution against
indecision.

upright.summary_zh: 活动、迅速、急迫、希望、向目标移动及爱的箭。
upright.text_en: Activity in undertakings, the path of such activity, swiftness, as that of an express messenger; great haste, great hope, speed towards an end which promises assured felicity; generally, that which is on the move; also the arrows of love.

reversed.summary_zh: 嫉妒、内部争执、良心不安、争吵与家庭争议。
reversed.text_en: Arrows of jealousy, internal dispute, stingings of conscience, quarrels; and domestic disputes for persons who are married.

symbolism.summary_zh: 八根权杖飞过开阔地，接近行程终点。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 准备接住密集变化，确认信息后及时行动。
editorial.reversed_zh: 行动很快时更要核对沟通，避免急促表达放大冲突。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 现在最需要及时说明的一件事是什么？
editorial.caution_zh: 逆位不自动等于“消息延迟”；不预测消息到达时间。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
WANDS. EIGHT.

The card represents motion through the immovable--a flight of wands
through an open country; but they draw to the term of their course. That
which they signify is at hand; it may be even on the threshold.
_Divinatory Meanings_: Activity in undertakings, the path of such
activity, swiftness, as that of an express messenger; great haste, great
hope, speed towards an end which promises assured felicity; generally,
that which is on the move; also the arrows of love. _Reversed_: Arrows
of jealousy, internal dispute, stingings of conscience, quarrels; and
domestic disputes for persons who are married.

upright.summary_zh: 对抗中的力量、勇敢承受攻击；也有延迟、暂停。
upright.text_en: The card signifies strength in opposition. If attacked, the person will meet an onslaught boldly; and his build shows that he may prove a formidable antagonist. With this main significance there are all its possible adjuncts--delay, suspension, adjournment.

reversed.summary_zh: 障碍、逆境与灾难等旧式表述。
reversed.text_en: Obstacles, adversity, calamity.

symbolism.summary_zh: 人物倚杖警戒，身后八根权杖排列如围栏。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 承认自己已经坚持很久，保留边界，也安排恢复精力的空间。
editorial.reversed_zh: 检查防守是否过度消耗，找出可以减轻负担的实际支援。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 哪些事需要继续坚持，哪些可以暂时交出去？
editorial.caution_zh: 不把戒备解释成真实威胁已被证实。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
WANDS. NINE.

The figure leans upon his staff and has an expectant look, as if
awaiting an enemy. Behind are eight other staves--erect, in orderly
disposition, like a palisade. _Divinatory Meanings_: The card signifies
strength in opposition. If attacked, the person will meet an onslaught
boldly; and his build shows that he may prove a formidable antagonist.
With this main significance there are all its possible adjuncts--delay,
suspension, adjournment. _Reversed_: Obstacles, adversity, calamity.

upright.summary_zh: 压迫、成功或收益带来的重担；另列伪装、背信等冲突解释。
upright.text_en: A card of many significances, and some of the readings cannot be harmonized. I set aside that which connects it with honor and good faith. The chief meaning is oppression simply, but it is also fortune, gain, any kind of success, and then it is the oppression of these things. It is also a card of false-seeming, disguise, perfidy. The place which the figure is approaching may suffer from the rods that he carries. Success is stultified if the Nine of Swords follows, and if it is a question of a lawsuit, there will be certain loss.

reversed.summary_zh: 阻碍、困难、暗中纠葛。
reversed.text_en: Contrarieties, difficulties, intrigues, and their analogies.

symbolism.summary_zh: 人物被携带的十根权杖压得弯身。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 检查承担的任务是否超过容量，给责任排序并讨论分担。
editorial.reversed_zh: 事情越纠结，越需要把职责与障碍逐项摊开。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 哪一项负担其实不需要你独自承担？
editorial.caution_zh: 不要默认逆位必定代表已经放下负担。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
WANDS. TEN.

A man oppressed by the weight of the ten staves which he is carrying.
_Divinatory Meanings_: A card of many significances, and some of the
readings cannot be harmonized. I set aside that which connects it with
honor and good faith. The chief meaning is oppression simply, but it is
also fortune, gain, any kind of success, and then it is the oppression
of these things. It is also a card of false-seeming, disguise, perfidy.
The place which the figure is approaching may suffer from the rods that
he carries. Success is stultified if the Nine of Swords follows, and if
it is a question of a lawsuit, there will be certain loss. _Reversed_:
Contrarieties, difficulties, intrigues, and their analogies.

upright.summary_zh: 忠诚的年轻人、信使、消息，也有受邻牌影响的旧式人物判断。
upright.text_en: Dark young man, faithful, a lover, an envoy, a postman. Beside a man, he will bear favorable testimony concerning him. A dangerous rival, if followed by the Page of Cups. Has the chief qualities of his suit. He may signify family intelligence.

reversed.summary_zh: 传闻、公告、不利消息、犹豫与不稳定。
reversed.text_en: Anecdotes, announcements, evil news. Also indecision and the instability which accompanies it.

symbolism.summary_zh: 年轻人物持杖，呈宣布消息的姿态。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 把好奇心变成提问或表达，主动确认新的消息。
editorial.reversed_zh: 区分传闻与事实，表达之前先明确自己真正想说什么。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你还需要问清哪件事，才愿意开始？
editorial.caution_zh: 不按肤色、年龄或性别锁定现实人物。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
WANDS. PAGE.

In a scene similar to the former, a young man stands in the act of
proclamation. He is unknown but faithful, and his tidings are strange.
_Divinatory Meanings_: Dark young man, faithful, a lover, an envoy, a
postman. Beside a man, he will bear favorable testimony concerning him.
A dangerous rival, if followed by the Page of Cups. Has the chief
qualities of his suit. He may signify family intelligence. _Reversed_:
Anecdotes, announcements, evil news. Also indecision and the instability
which accompanies it.

upright.summary_zh: 离开、缺席、迁移与住所变化。
upright.text_en: Departure, absence, flight, emigration. A dark young man, friendly. Change of residence.

reversed.summary_zh: 断裂、分离、中断与不和。
reversed.text_en: Rupture, division, interruption, discord.

symbolism.summary_zh: 骑者策马经过土丘，动作带有急促感。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 如果想迅速行动，先确认目的地、准备和实际代价。
editorial.reversed_zh: 面对被打断的计划，先找出中断原因，再决定调整或暂停。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你现在是在奔向目标，还是急着离开不适？
editorial.caution_zh: 不预测搬家或必然分离。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
WANDS. KNIGHT.

He is shown as if upon a journey, armed with a short wand, and although
mailed is not on a warlike errand. He is passing mounds or pyramids. The
motion of the horse is a key to the character of its rider, and suggests
the precipitate mood, or things connected therewith. _Divinatory
Meanings_: Departure, absence, flight, emigration. A dark young man,
friendly. Change of residence. _Reversed_: Rupture, division,
interruption, discord.

upright.summary_zh: 友善、爱、荣誉，也有重视金钱或商业成功。
upright.text_en: A dark woman, country-woman, friendly, chaste, loving, honorable. If the card beside her signifies a man, she is well disposed towards him; if a woman, she is interested in the Querent. Also, love of money, or a certain success in business.

reversed.summary_zh: 善良、节俭、助人；在特定组合下另有反对、嫉妒、欺骗解释。
reversed.text_en: Good, economical, obliging, serviceable. Signifies also--but in certain positions and in the neighborhood of other cards tending in such directions--opposition, jealousy, even deceit and infidelity.

symbolism.summary_zh: 持有生叶权杖的王后，作者强调活力与吸引力。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 用温暖而主动的方式表达想法，让热情与实际能力相配。
editorial.reversed_zh: 先考虑帮助与节制这一分支；涉及比较或嫉妒时必须有用户提供的事实。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 怎样展现自己，又不需要和别人比较？
editorial.caution_zh: 不能因为逆位就断言某位女性不忠。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
WANDS. QUEEN.

The Wands throughout this suit are always in leaf, as it is a suit of
life and animation. Emotionally and otherwise, the Queen's personality
corresponds to that of the King, but is more magnetic. _Divinatory
Meanings_: A dark woman, country-woman, friendly, chaste, loving,
honorable. If the card beside her signifies a man, she is well disposed
towards him; if a woman, she is interested in the Querent. Also, love of
money, or a certain success in business. _Reversed_: Good, economical,
obliging, serviceable. Signifies also--but in certain positions and in
the neighborhood of other cards tending in such directions--opposition,
jealousy, even deceit and infidelity.

upright.summary_zh: 友善、诚实、认真负责；另有继承消息。
upright.text_en: Dark man, friendly, countryman, generally married, honest and conscientious. The card always signifies honesty, and may mean news concerning an unexpected heritage to fall in before very long.

reversed.summary_zh: 善良但严厉、严肃而宽容。
reversed.text_en: Good, but severe; austere, yet tolerant.

symbolism.summary_zh: 国王举生叶权杖，宝座带有狮子图案。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 以诚实和承担责任来带动事情，说明你愿意负责的部分。
editorial.reversed_zh: 严要求可以与宽容并存，检查自己的标准是否说清楚了。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你希望别人从你的行动中看到什么承诺？
editorial.caution_zh: 不把逆位简化为暴躁或滥权。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
THE SUIT OF WANDS. KING.

The physical and emotional nature to which this card is attributed is
dark, ardent, lithe, animated, impassioned, noble. The King uplifts a
flowering wand, and wears, like his three correspondences in the
remaining suits, what is called a cap of maintenance beneath his crown.
He connects with the symbol of the lion, which is emblazoned on the back
of his throne. _Divinatory Meanings_: Dark man, friendly, countryman,
generally married, honest and conscientious. The card always signifies
honesty, and may mean news concerning an unexpected heritage to fall in
before very long. _Reversed_: Good, but severe; austere, yet tolerant.

upright.summary_zh: 真诚之心的居所、喜悦、满足、滋养、丰足与生育力。
upright.text_en: House of the true heart, joy, content, abode, nourishment, abundance, fertility; Holy Table, felicity hereof.

reversed.summary_zh: 虚假之心的居所、变化、不稳定与变革。
reversed.text_en: House of the false heart, mutation, instability, revolution.

symbolism.summary_zh: 云中之手托杯，水流下落，鸽子向杯中衔来圣饼。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 留意能滋养你的关系与体验，允许感受被表达。
editorial.reversed_zh: 感情或期待发生变化时，先诚实辨认自己的需要。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 什么样的关心是你现在能够接住的？
editorial.caution_zh: 不把生育意象用于怀孕预测。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. ACE.

The waters are beneath, and thereon are water-lilies; the hand issues
from the cloud, holding in its palm the cup, from which four streams are
pouring; a dove, bearing in its bill a cross-marked Host, descends to
place the Wafer in the Cup; the dew of water is falling on all sides. It
is an intimation of that which may lie behind the Lesser Arcana.
_Divinatory Meanings_: House of the true heart, joy, content, abode,
nourishment, abundance, fertility; Holy Table, felicity hereof.
_Reversed_: House of the false heart, mutation, instability,
revolution.

upright.summary_zh: 爱情、热情、友谊、亲和、结合、和谐与共鸣。
upright.text_en: Love, passion, friendship, affinity, union, concord, sympathy, the inter-relation of the sexes, and--as a suggestion apart from all offices of divination--that desire which is not in Nature, but by which Nature is sanctified.

reversed.summary_zh: 主要条目未单列逆位；补充牌义章节给出“激情”。
reversed.text_en: Passion.

symbolism.summary_zh: 两个人举杯相对，上方有双蛇杖和狮首。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 关注双方都愿意参与的连接，通过沟通确认彼此的期待。
editorial.reversed_zh: 本次来源只提供激情这一补充提示；可以讨论感情的强度，不能自动判断关系失衡或分手。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你希望对方明确知道什么，也愿意听到什么？
editorial.caution_zh: 逆位依据来自第三部分第四节，不能伪装成主要条目中的内容。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. TWO.

A youth and maiden are pledging one another, and above their cups rises
the Caduceus of Hermes, between the great wings of which there appears a
lion's head. It is a variant of a sign which is found in a few old
examples of this card. Some curious emblematical meanings are attached
to it, but they do not concern us in this place. _Divinatory Meanings_:
Love, passion, friendship, affinity, union, concord, sympathy, the
inter-relation of the sexes, and--as a suggestion apart from all offices
of divination--that desire which is not in Nature, but by which Nature
is sanctified.

reversal_supplement.text_en:
_Two._--Favorable in things of pleasure and business, as well as in
     love; also wealth and honor.
     _Reversed_: Passion.

upright.summary_zh: 圆满完成、欢乐、成功、满足、安慰与疗愈。
upright.text_en: The conclusion of any matter in plenty, perfection and merriment; happy issue, victory, fulfilment, solace, healing.

reversed.summary_zh: 迅速办理、达成、结束；也包括感官享乐过度。
reversed.text_en: Expedition, dispatch, achievement, end. It signifies also the side of excess in physical enjoyment, and the pleasures of the senses.

symbolism.summary_zh: 三位人物在园中举杯相庆。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 与支持你的人分享成果，让连接带来轻松和安慰。
editorial.reversed_zh: 检查聚会、享乐或赶快结束事情是否超出自己的节奏。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 和谁在一起，你更容易放松地做自己？
editorial.caution_zh: 不能由三个人物推断第三者关系。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. THREE.

Maidens in a garden-ground with cups uplifted, as if pledging one
another. _Divinatory Meanings_: The conclusion of any matter in plenty,
perfection and merriment; happy issue, victory, fulfilment, solace,
healing. _Reversed_: Expedition, dispatch, achievement, end. It
signifies also the side of excess in physical enjoyment, and the
pleasures of the senses.

upright.summary_zh: 疲倦、厌恶、不满、想象中的烦恼与混合的快乐。
upright.text_en: Weariness, disgust, aversion, imaginary vexations, as if the wine of this world had caused satiety only; another wine, as if a fairy gift, is now offered the wastrel, but he sees no consolation therein. This is also a card of blended pleasure.

reversed.summary_zh: 新事物、预兆、新指导和新关系。
reversed.text_en: Novelty, presage, new instruction, new relations.

symbolism.summary_zh: 树下人物面对三杯，云中之手又递来一杯。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 承认提不起兴趣的感受，分辨需要休息还是需要不同的体验。
editorial.reversed_zh: 试着接触一个新的观点或邀请，但保留自己的选择权。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你是真的不想要，还是现在没有余力回应？
editorial.caution_zh: 不能据此诊断抑郁或要求用户立刻积极。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. FOUR.

A young man is seated under a tree and contemplates three cups set on
the grass before him; an arm issuing from a cloud offers him another
cup. His expression notwithstanding is one of discontent with his
environment. _Divinatory Meanings_: Weariness, disgust, aversion,
imaginary vexations, as if the wine of this world had caused satiety
only; another wine, as if a fairy gift, is now offered the wastrel, but
he sees no consolation therein. This is also a card of blended pleasure.
_Reversed_: Novelty, presage, new instruction, new relations.

upright.summary_zh: 失去但仍有所保留；继承未达期待，另有带苦涩的婚姻解释。
upright.text_en: It is a card of loss, but something remains over; three have been taken, but two are left; it is a card of inheritance, patrimony, transmission, but not corresponding to expectations; with some interpreters it is a card of marriage, but not without bitterness or frustration.

reversed.summary_zh: 消息、联盟、亲缘、祖先、归来及不切实际的计划。
reversed.text_en: News, alliances, affinity, consanguinity, ancestry, return, false projects.

symbolism.summary_zh: 披斗篷的人面对三只倒杯，身后仍立着两杯。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 允许自己为失去难过，再看看尚存的资源或关系。
editorial.reversed_zh: 可以关注重新联结的机会，同时核实期待是否现实。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你不必立刻释怀，但身边还有什么可以支持你？
editorial.caution_zh: 逆位不保证旧人回归或复合。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. FIVE.

A dark, cloaked figure, looking sideways at three prone cups; two others
stand upright behind him; a bridge is in the background, leading to a
small keep or holding. _Divinatory Meanings_: It is a card of loss, but
something remains over; three have been taken, but two are left; it is a
card of inheritance, patrimony, transmission, but not corresponding to
expectations; with some interpreters it is a card of marriage, but not
without bitterness or frustration. _Reversed_: News, alliances,
affinity, consanguinity, ancestry, return, false projects.

upright.summary_zh: 过去、童年记忆和昔日快乐；另有新关系、新知识与新环境的相反解释。
upright.text_en: A card of the past and of memories, looking back, as--for example--on childhood; happiness, enjoyment, but coming rather from the past; things that have vanished. Another reading reverses this, giving new relations, new knowledge, new environment, and then the children are disporting in an unfamiliar precinct.

reversed.summary_zh: 未来、更新和即将发生的事。
reversed.text_en: The future, renewal, that which will come to pass presently.

symbolism.summary_zh: 旧花园中的孩子与装满花的杯。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 回看旧经验带给你的温暖，也辨认它是否仍适合现在。
editorial.reversed_zh: 把注意力转向可以更新的生活安排，而不只停留在记忆中。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 过去的哪种需要，今天仍值得被照顾？
editorial.caution_zh: 不把回忆直接解释成前任会回来。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. SIX.

Children in an old garden, their cups filled with flowers. _Divinatory
Meanings_: A card of the past and of memories, looking back, as--for
example--on childhood; happiness, enjoyment, but coming rather from the
past; things that have vanished. Another reading reverses this, giving
new relations, new knowledge, new environment, and then the children are
disporting in an unfamiliar precinct. _Reversed_: The future, renewal,
that which will come to pass presently.

upright.summary_zh: 想象、感受、沉思中的图景；可能有些收获但缺少持久实质。
upright.text_en: Fairy favors, images of reflection, sentiment, imagination, things seen in the glass of contemplation; some attainment in these degrees, but nothing permanent or substantial is suggested.

reversed.summary_zh: 欲望、意志、决心与计划。
reversed.text_en: Desire, will, determination, project.

symbolism.summary_zh: 杯中呈现各种幻想般的形象。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 先把愿景列出来，再区分想象、信息和可以验证的选择。
editorial.reversed_zh: 选定一个愿望，给它明确的行动和检验条件。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 哪一个选项值得先用实际行动验证？
editorial.caution_zh: 不把想象内容当成事实揭示。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. SEVEN.

Strange chalices of vision, but the images are more especially those of
the fantastic spirit. _Divinatory Meanings_: Fairy favors, images of
reflection, sentiment, imagination, things seen in the glass of
contemplation; some attainment in these degrees, but nothing permanent
or substantial is suggested. _Reversed_: Desire, will, determination,
project.

upright.summary_zh: 事情衰退或原以为重要的事其实不重要；另有喜悦、谦逊等相反解释。
upright.text_en: The card speaks for itself on the surface, but other readings are entirely antithetical--giving joy, mildness, timidity, honor, modesty. In practice, it is usually found that the card shows the decline of a matter, or that a matter which has been thought to be important is really of slight consequence--either for good or evil.

reversed.summary_zh: 很大的喜悦、幸福与宴饮。
reversed.text_en: Great joy, happiness, feasting.

symbolism.summary_zh: 人物离开原先放置的杯。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 重新衡量一件事对你的意义，思考继续投入是否仍值得。
editorial.reversed_zh: 可以关注重新体验快乐的可能，不默认你必须回头或无法离开。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你愿意继续投入，是因为珍惜还是因为已经付出很多？
editorial.caution_zh: 此来源逆位不是固定的“害怕离开”。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. EIGHT.

A man of dejected aspect is deserting the cups of his felicity,
enterprise, undertaking or previous concern. _Divinatory Meanings_: The
card speaks for itself on the surface, but other readings are entirely
antithetical--giving joy, mildness, timidity, honor, modesty. In
practice, it is usually found that the card shows the decline of a
matter, or that a matter which has been thought to be important is
really of slight consequence--either for good or evil. _Reversed_: Great
joy, happiness, feasting.

upright.summary_zh: 和谐、满足、身体舒适、成功与优势。
upright.text_en: Concord, contentment, physical _bien-être_; also victory, success, advantage; satisfaction for the Querent or person for whom the consultation is made.

reversed.summary_zh: 真诚、忠诚、自由；另有错误与不完美。
reversed.text_en: Truth, loyalty, liberty; but the readings vary and include mistakes, imperfections, etc.

symbolism.summary_zh: 人物坐在摆满酒杯的弧形台前，显得满足。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 辨认真正让你满足的事，享受成果而不必向别人证明。
editorial.reversed_zh: 检查满足是否真实，也给不完美留出空间。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 如果没有旁人的评价，你仍然想要什么？
editorial.caution_zh: 不保证愿望必然实现。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. NINE.

A goodly personage has feasted to his heart's content, and abundant
refreshment of wine is on the arched counter behind him, seeming to
indicate that the future is also assured. The picture offers the
material side only, but there are other aspects. _Divinatory Meanings_:
Concord, contentment, physical _bien-être_; also victory, success,
advantage; satisfaction for the Querent or person for whom the
consultation is made. _Reversed_: Truth, loyalty, liberty; but the
readings vary and include mistakes, imperfections, etc.

upright.summary_zh: 全心满足、爱与友谊的圆满，也指居住环境。
upright.text_en: Contentment, repose of the entire heart; the perfection of that state; also perfection of human love and friendship; if with several picture-cards, a person who is taking charge of the Querent's interests; also the town, village or country inhabited by the Querent.

reversed.summary_zh: 虚假之心的安逸、愤怒与暴力。
reversed.text_en: Repose of the false heart, indignation, violence.

symbolism.summary_zh: 彩虹中的十杯下，人们与孩子处在家庭场景里。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 想一想怎样的相处和环境能让你拥有归属感。
editorial.reversed_zh: 留意表面和谐是否掩盖了真实不满，讨论可观察的相处问题。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你理想的归属感，具体体现在哪些日常小事？
editorial.caution_zh: 牌面不能证明家庭暴力或关系事实。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. TEN.

Appearance of Cups in a rainbow; it is contemplated in wonder and
ecstasy by a man and woman below, evidently husband and wife. His right
arm is about her; his left is raised upward; she raises her right arm.
The two children dancing near them have not observed the prodigy but are
happy after their own manner. There is a home-scene beyond. _Divinatory
Meanings_: Contentment, repose of the entire heart; the perfection of
that state; also perfection of human love and friendship; if with
several picture-cards, a person who is taking charge of the Querent's
interests; also the town, village or country inhabited by the Querent.
_Reversed_: Repose of the false heart, indignation, violence.

upright.summary_zh: 乐于服务的年轻人、学习、消息、应用、反思与沉思。
upright.text_en: Fair young man, one impelled to render service and with whom the Querent will be connected; a studious youth; news, message; application, reflection, meditation; also these things directed to business.

reversed.summary_zh: 喜好、倾向、依恋、诱惑、欺骗与技巧。
reversed.text_en: Taste, inclination, attachment, seduction, deception, artifice.

symbolism.summary_zh: 年轻人专注看杯中探出的鱼。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 温柔地表达一个感受，保持好奇，并认真听取回应。
editorial.reversed_zh: 留意依恋是否让你忽略事实，先核对信息再投入期待。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你有什么感受想说出来，但还没找到表达方式？
editorial.caution_zh: 不将侍从固定为某个年龄或性别的人。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. PAGE.

A fair, pleasing, somewhat effeminate page, of studious and intent
aspect, contemplates a fish rising from a cup to look at him. It is the
pictures of the mind taking form. _Divinatory Meanings_: Fair young man,
one impelled to render service and with whom the Querent will be
connected; a studious youth; news, message; application, reflection,
meditation; also these things directed to business. _Reversed_: Taste,
inclination, attachment, seduction, deception, artifice.

upright.summary_zh: 到来、接近、提议、邀请和推动。
upright.text_en: Arrival, approach--sometimes that of a messenger; advances, proposition, demeanor, invitation, incitement.

reversed.summary_zh: 诡计、伪装、欺骗与两面性。
reversed.text_en: Trickery, artifice, subtlety, swindling, duplicity, fraud.

symbolism.summary_zh: 骑者缓缓前行，举杯，头盔带翼饰。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 可以回应或发出一个邀请，同时把愿景说得具体。
editorial.reversed_zh: 比较言语与行动的一致性，避免仅凭漂亮承诺下结论。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 这个邀请落实到日常，会是什么样子？
editorial.caution_zh: 逆位只是核实提示，不能证明某人欺骗。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. KNIGHT.

Graceful, but not warlike; riding quietly, wearing a winged helmet,
referring to those higher graces of the imagination which sometimes
characterize this card. He too is a dreamer, but the images of the side
of sense haunt him in his vision. _Divinatory Meanings_: Arrival,
approach--sometimes that of a messenger; advances, proposition,
demeanor, invitation, incitement. _Reversed_: Trickery, artifice,
subtlety, swindling, duplicity, fraud.

upright.summary_zh: 诚实、投入、关爱式理解、快乐、智慧与帮助。
upright.text_en: Good, fair woman; honest, devoted woman, who will do service to the Querent; loving intelligence, and hence the gift of vision; success, happiness, pleasure; also wisdom, virtue; a perfect spouse and a good mother.

reversed.summary_zh: 不同解释相冲突：善良的人，或不可轻信及失德的人。
reversed.text_en: The accounts vary; good woman; otherwise, distinguished woman but one not to be trusted; perverse woman; vice, dishonor, depravity.

symbolism.summary_zh: 王后凝望杯，作者强调她既想象也行动。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 把共情落实为合适的关心，也照顾自己的感受。
editorial.reversed_zh: 资料本身存在分歧；可以先讨论信任与关怀边界，不为任何人贴标签。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 怎样关心对方，才不会把自己放在最后？
editorial.caution_zh: 不能用牌评判女性品德或母职。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
CUPS. QUEEN.

Beautiful, fair, dreamy--as one who sees visions in a cup. This is,
however, only one of her aspects; she sees, but she also acts, and her
activity feeds her dream. _Divinatory Meanings_: Good, fair woman;
honest, devoted woman, who will do service to the Querent; loving
intelligence, and hence the gift of vision; success, happiness,
pleasure; also wisdom, virtue; a perfect spouse and a good mother.
_Reversed_: The accounts vary; good woman; otherwise, distinguished
woman but one not to be trusted; perverse woman; vice, dishonor,
depravity.

upright.summary_zh: 责任、助人、公平、艺术、科学与创造性智慧。
upright.text_en: Fair man, man of business, law, or divinity; responsible, disposed to oblige the Querent; also equity, art and science, including those who profess science, law and art; creative intelligence.

reversed.summary_zh: 不诚实、两面、勒索、不公、丑闻与损失。
reversed.text_en: Dishonest, double-dealing man; roguery, exaction, injustice, vice, scandal, pillage, considerable loss.

symbolism.summary_zh: 国王的宝座在海上，持杯与短权杖，旁有船和跃起的海豚。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 在复杂情绪中保持负责，兼顾感受和公平的行动。
editorial.reversed_zh: 当话语与责任不一致时，回到具体行为和清楚边界。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 在照顾情绪的同时，你愿意承担哪项责任？
editorial.caution_zh: 不能直接断言第三方操控或品行不端。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
THE SUIT OF CUPS. KING.

He holds a short scepter in his left hand and a great cup in his right;
his throne is set upon the sea; on one side a ship is riding and on the
other a dolphin is leaping. The implicit is that the Sign of the Cup
naturally refers to water, which appears in all the court cards.
_Divinatory Meanings_: Fair man, man of business, law, or divinity;
responsible, disposed to oblige the Querent; also equity, art and
science, including those who profess science, law and art; creative
intelligence. _Reversed_: Dishonest, double-dealing man; roguery,
exaction, injustice, vice, scandal, pillage, considerable loss.

upright.summary_zh: 胜利、征服、强力，以及各方面达到过度程度。
upright.text_en: Triumph, the excessive degree in everything, conquest, triumph of force. It is a card of great force, in love as well as in hatred. The crown may carry a much higher significance than comes usually within the sphere of fortune-telling.

reversed.summary_zh: 同类力量产生破坏性结果；另有受孕、出生、增长的解释。
reversed.text_en: The same, but the results are disastrous; another account says--conception--childbirth, augmentation, multiplicity.

symbolism.summary_zh: 云中之手握剑，剑尖穿过王冠。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 用清楚的判断推动事情，也检查强硬手段的代价。
editorial.reversed_zh: 表达或决定过于锋利时，先调整方式，保留可协商空间。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你需要说清楚什么，又可以怎样减少伤害？
editorial.caution_zh: 不把剑当成“发现绝对真相”的保证，也不预测生育。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. ACE.

A hand issues from a cloud, grasping a sword, the point of which is
encircled by a crown. _Divinatory Meanings_: Triumph, the excessive
degree in everything, conquest, triumph of force. It is a card of great
force, in love as well as in hatred. The crown may carry a much higher
significance than comes usually within the sphere of fortune-telling.
_Reversed_: The same, but the results are disastrous; another account
says--conception--childbirth, augmentation, multiplicity.

upright.summary_zh: 顺应、均衡、勇气、友谊和带防备的和谐；作者对有利解释加以保留。
upright.text_en: Conformity and the equipoise which it suggests, courage, friendship, concord in a state of arms; another reading gives tenderness, affection, intimacy. The suggestion of harmony and other favorable readings must be considered in a qualified manner, as Swords generally are not symbolical of beneficent forces in human affairs.

reversed.summary_zh: 假冒、谎言、两面与不忠。
reversed.text_en: Imposture, falsehood, duplicity, disloyalty.

symbolism.summary_zh: 蒙眼人物平衡着两把剑。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 辨认目前的平衡依靠什么，哪些分歧仍未真正讨论。
editorial.reversed_zh: 核查重要信息和承诺，但不要把疑心当成已证实的欺骗。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 维持眼前平静，需要付出什么代价？
editorial.caution_zh: “无法选择”属于进一步改写，不是原典唯一解释。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. TWO.

A hoodwinked female figure balances two swords upon her shoulders.
_Divinatory Meanings_: Conformity and the equipoise which it suggests,
courage, friendship, concord in a state of arms; another reading gives
tenderness, affection, intimacy. The suggestion of harmony and other
favorable readings must be considered in a qualified manner, as Swords
generally are not symbolical of beneficent forces in human affairs.
_Reversed_: Imposture, falsehood, duplicity, disloyalty.

upright.summary_zh: 离开、缺席、延误、分裂、断裂与散开。
upright.text_en: Removal, absence, delay, division, rupture, dispersion, and all that the design signifies naturally, being too simple and obvious to call for specific enumeration.

reversed.summary_zh: 精神疏离、错误、损失、分心、失序与混乱等旧式表述。
reversed.text_en: Mental alienation, error, loss, distraction, disorder, confusion.

symbolism.summary_zh: 三剑刺穿心形，背景为云雨。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 承认分离或分歧带来的痛感，用具体语言说出受伤之处。
editorial.reversed_zh: 先整理混乱信息和感受，不急着给事情作永久判断。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 最让你难受的是已经发生的事，还是它可能意味着什么？
editorial.caution_zh: 不把逆位自动解释成已经疗愈；不诊断精神疾病。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. THREE.

Three swords piercing a heart; cloud and rain behind. _Divinatory
Meanings_: Removal, absence, delay, division, rupture, dispersion, and
all that the design signifies naturally, being too simple and obvious to
call for specific enumeration. _Reversed_: Mental alienation, error,
loss, distraction, disorder, confusion.

upright.summary_zh: 警觉、退避、独处、隐居休息；也有墓葬意象。
upright.text_en: Vigilance, retreat, solitude, hermit's repose, exile, tomb and coffin. It is these last that have suggested the design.

reversed.summary_zh: 明智管理、谨慎、节约、贪吝、预防和遗嘱。
reversed.text_en: Wise administration, circumspection, economy, avarice, precaution, testament.

symbolism.summary_zh: 骑士像以祈祷姿态平卧在墓上。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 为自己留出休整和梳理的空间，暂时减少外部刺激。
editorial.reversed_zh: 用谨慎的安排管理精力与资源，而不默认必须立刻恢复忙碌。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 什么安排能让你的休息真正得到保护？
editorial.caution_zh: 不由墓葬意象推断死亡。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. FOUR.

The effigy of a knight in the attitude of prayer, at full length upon
his tomb. _Divinatory Meanings_: Vigilance, retreat, solitude, hermit's
repose, exile, tomb and coffin. It is these last that have suggested the
design. _Reversed_: Wise administration, circumspection, economy,
avarice, precaution, testament.

upright.summary_zh: 贬损、毁坏、撤回、失誉与损失。
upright.text_en: Degradation, destruction, revocation, infamy, dishonor, loss, with the variants and analogues of these.

reversed.summary_zh: 类似含义，另有埋葬与葬仪。
reversed.text_en: The same; burial and obsequies.

symbolism.summary_zh: 人物持剑，看着两人沮丧退去，地上还有剑。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 检查一场冲突即使赢了是否仍造成损失，考虑怎样止损。
editorial.reversed_zh: 冲突的余波可能仍需处理，先修复可修复的部分。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你愿意放下什么，换取不再继续消耗？
editorial.caution_zh: 不把逆位自动归为和解，也不预测死亡。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. FIVE.

A disdainful man looks after two retreating and dejected figures. Their
swords lie upon the ground. He carries two others on his left shoulder,
and a third sword is in his right hand, point to earth. He is the master
in possession of the field. _Divinatory Meanings_: Degradation,
destruction, revocation, infamy, dishonor, loss, with the variants and
analogues of these. _Reversed_: The same; burial and obsequies.

upright.summary_zh: 水上旅程、路径、信使、代理与权宜办法。
upright.text_en: Journey by water, route, way, envoy, commissionary, expedient.

reversed.summary_zh: 声明、坦白、公开；另有爱的提议。
reversed.text_en: Declaration, confession, publicity; one account says that it is a proposal of love.

symbolism.summary_zh: 船夫载乘客驶向对岸，水路较平稳。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 寻找从当前处境走向下一阶段的可行路径，允许借助帮助。
editorial.reversed_zh: 如果有事情需要说明，可以准备一次清楚而有边界的表达。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 为了迈向下一步，你需要谁的帮助或哪条信息？
editorial.caution_zh: 此来源逆位不是固定的“无法前进”。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. SIX.

A ferryman carrying passengers in his punt to the further shore. The
course is smooth, and seeing that the freight is light, it may be noted
that the work is not beyond his strength. _Divinatory Meanings_: Journey
by water, route, way, envoy, commissionary, expedient. _Reversed_:
Declaration, confession, publicity; one account says that it is a
proposal of love.

upright.summary_zh: 计划、尝试、愿望、希望、自信；也有争执、可能失败的计划和烦扰。
upright.text_en: Design, attempt, wish, hope, confidence; also quarrelling, a plan that may fail, annoyance. The design is uncertain in its import, because the significations are widely at variance with each other.

reversed.summary_zh: 好建议、指导；亦有诽谤和闲言。
reversed.text_en: Good advice, counsel, instruction, slander, babbling.

symbolism.summary_zh: 人物带走五剑，另两剑留在地上，附近有营地。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 检验方案是否稳妥，尤其注意没有处理完的部分。
editorial.reversed_zh: 主动寻求可靠建议，并把有用反馈与流言区分开。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 计划里哪一部分还没有被验证？
editorial.caution_zh: 作者承认牌义分歧，不能把此牌等同于偷窃或不忠。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. SEVEN.

A man in the act of carrying away five swords rapidly; the two others of
the card remain stuck in the ground. A camp, is close at hand.
_Divinatory Meanings_: Design, attempt, wish, hope, confidence; also
quarrelling, a plan that may fail, annoyance. The design is uncertain in
its import, because the significations are widely at variance with each
other. _Reversed_: Good advice, counsel, instruction, slander,
babbling.

upright.summary_zh: 不利消息、危机、责难、受限的力量、冲突与诽谤，另有疾病说法。
upright.text_en: Bad news, violent chagrin, crisis, censure, power in trammels, conflict, calumny; also sickness.

reversed.summary_zh: 不安、困难、反对、意外、背信、未知与宿命。
reversed.text_en: Disquiet, difficulty, opposition, accident, treachery; what is unforeseen; fatality.

symbolism.summary_zh: 被绑且蒙眼的人被剑围绕，作者说是暂时受困。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 列出真实限制与尚可选择的部分，从一项可改变的条件开始。
editorial.reversed_zh: 面对未知时先补信息和支持，不把受困完全归咎于自己。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 哪些限制来自现实，哪些还没有经过验证？
editorial.caution_zh: 不说“一切都是你想出来的”，不预测疾病或事故。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. EIGHT.

A woman, bound and hoodwinked, with the swords of the card about her.
Yet it is rather a card of temporary durance than of irretrievable
bondage. _Divinatory Meanings_: Bad news, violent chagrin, crisis,
censure, power in trammels, conflict, calumny; also sickness.
_Reversed_: Disquiet, difficulty, opposition, accident, treachery; what
is unforeseen; fatality.

upright.summary_zh: 失败、延迟、欺骗、失望与绝望；原文还列死亡和流产。
upright.text_en: Death, failure, miscarriage, delay, deception, disappointment, despair.

reversed.summary_zh: 受困、怀疑、疑虑、恐惧与羞耻。
reversed.text_en: Imprisonment, suspicion, doubt, reasonable fear, shame.

symbolism.summary_zh: 人物坐在床上悲恸，背后排列着剑。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 把最困扰你的担忧写具体，区分当前事实与脑中反复出现的最坏情况。
editorial.reversed_zh: 如果怀疑或羞耻使你难以开口，先找一个安全的表达或支持渠道。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你现在需要的是更多信息，还是有人陪你承受这份担心？
editorial.caution_zh: 历史疾病与死亡词条不能作为现实预测或诊断。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. NINE.

One seated on her couch in lamentation, with the swords over her. She is
as one who knows no sorrow which is like unto hers. It is a card of
utter desolation. _Divinatory Meanings_: Death, failure, miscarriage,
delay, deception, disappointment, despair. _Reversed_: Imprisonment,
suspicion, doubt, reasonable fear, shame.

upright.summary_zh: 痛苦、悲伤、眼泪与荒凉；作者明确说并非特别指暴力死亡。
upright.text_en: Whatsoever is intimated by the design; also pain, affliction, tears, sadness, desolation. It is not especially a card of violent death.

reversed.summary_zh: 优势、收益、成功、帮助，但不持久；也有权力。
reversed.text_en: Advantage, profit, success, favor, but none of these are permanent; also power and authority.

symbolism.summary_zh: 人物伏地，十剑刺在其身。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 如果一件事已让你耗尽，先承认它的损害，再安排恢复和收尾。
editorial.reversed_zh: 出现缓解时先稳住条件，不把暂时好转当作所有问题都解决。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 眼下哪一种支持能让你先缓一口气？
editorial.caution_zh: 不可按画面推断暴力死亡或身体伤害。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. TEN.

A prostrate figure, pierced by all the swords belonging to the card.
_Divinatory Meanings_: Whatsoever is intimated by the design; also pain,
affliction, tears, sadness, desolation. It is not especially a card of
violent death. _Reversed_: Advantage, profit, success, favor, but none
of these are permanent; also power and authority.

upright.summary_zh: 权威、监督、秘密服务、警觉、侦察与检查。
upright.text_en: Authority, overseeing, secret service, vigilance, spying, examination, and the qualities thereto belonging.

reversed.summary_zh: 这些品质的不利面、未预料到的事、准备不足；另有疾病说法。
reversed.text_en: More evil side of these qualities; what is unforeseen, unprepared state; sickness is also intimated.

symbolism.summary_zh: 年轻人物双手持剑，行于崎岖地面并左右观察。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 用好奇而审慎的态度收集信息，先问清楚再表达判断。
editorial.reversed_zh: 留意准备不足或过度戒备，补充事实而不是增加猜测。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你还缺哪条直接信息？
editorial.caution_zh: 不把牌面侦察意象写成有人监视用户。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. PAGE.

A lithe, active figure holds a sword upright in both hands, while in the
act of swift walking. He is passing over rugged land, and about his way
the clouds are collocated wildly. He is alert and lithe, looking this
way and that, as if an expected enemy might appear at any moment.
_Divinatory Meanings_: Authority, overseeing, secret service, vigilance,
spying, examination, and the qualities thereto belonging. _Reversed_:
More evil side of these qualities; what is unforeseen, unprepared state;
sickness is also intimated.

upright.summary_zh: 技能、勇敢、能力、防卫，也有愤怒、冲突、破坏与抵抗。
upright.text_en: Skill, bravery, capacity, defense, address, enmity, wrath, war, destruction, opposition, resistance, ruin. There is therefore a sense in which the card signifies death, but it carries this meaning only in its proximity to other cards of fatality.

reversed.summary_zh: 轻率、能力不足与过度消耗。
reversed.text_en: Imprudence, incapacity, extravagance.

symbolism.summary_zh: 骑士全速向前，呈奋战姿态。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 行动前先确认目标和边界，让速度服务于清楚的判断。
editorial.reversed_zh: 先降低冲动带来的风险，必要时补技能或寻求协助。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 这件事真的需要马上行动吗？
editorial.caution_zh: 不鼓励冲突，不按牌预测伤害。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. KNIGHT.

He is riding in full course, as if scattering his enemies. In the design
he is really a proto-typical hero of romantic chivalry. He might almost
be Galahad, whose sword is swift and sure because he is clean of heart.
_Divinatory Meanings_: Skill, bravery, capacity, defense, address,
enmity, wrath, war, destruction, opposition, resistance, ruin. There is
therefore a sense in which the card signifies death, but it carries this
meaning only in its proximity to other cards of fatality. _Reversed_:
Imprudence, incapacity, extravagance.

upright.summary_zh: 丧偶、悲伤、缺席、匮乏与分离，另有旧式性别和生育描述。
upright.text_en: Widowhood, female sadness and embarrassment, absence, sterility, mourning, privation, separation.

reversed.summary_zh: 恶意、偏执、伪装、拘谨与欺骗。
reversed.text_en: Malice, bigotry, artifice, prudery, bale, deceit.

symbolism.summary_zh: 王后举剑，另一手向外伸，面容严肃且带有哀伤。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 承认经历留下的悲伤，并思考怎样清楚地保护自己的边界。
editorial.reversed_zh: 如果表达因受伤变得尖锐，先区分事实与对他人的整体评判。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你想保护的边界是什么，怎样说更清楚？
editorial.caution_zh: “独立理性女性”不是本来源完整原义；不以牌判断女性品德。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
SWORDS. QUEEN.

Her right hand raises the weapon vertically and the hilt rests on an arm
of her royal chair; the left hand is extended, the arm raised; her
countenance is severe but chastened; it suggests familiarity with
sorrow. It does not represent mercy, and, her sword notwithstanding, she
is scarcely a symbol of power. _Divinatory Meanings_: Widowhood, female
sadness and embarrassment, absence, sterility, mourning, privation,
separation. _Reversed_: Malice, bigotry, artifice, prudery, bale,
deceit.

upright.summary_zh: 判断、权力、命令、权威、理智、法律与职务。
upright.text_en: Whatsoever arises out of the idea of judgment and all its connections--power, command, authority, militant intelligence, law, offices of the crown, and so forth.

reversed.summary_zh: 残酷、乖戾、野蛮、背信与恶意。
reversed.text_en: Cruelty, perversity, barbarity, perfidy, evil intention.

symbolism.summary_zh: 国王持出鞘之剑，以审判者姿态端坐。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 制定透明的判断标准，并愿意为决定说明理由。
editorial.reversed_zh: 检查权力是否变得苛刻，给不同意见和补充证据留出位置。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你的决定依据是什么，是否适用于所有人？
editorial.caution_zh: 不能据此确定真实法律或权威机构的决定。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
THE SUIT OF SWORDS. KING.

He sits in judgment, holding the unsheathed sign of his suit. He
recalls, of course, the conventional Symbol of Justice in the Trumps
Major, and he may represent this virtue, but he is rather the power of
life and death, in virtue of his office. _Divinatory Meanings_:
Whatsoever arises out of the idea of judgment and all its
connections--power, command, authority, militant intelligence, law,
offices of the crown, and so forth. _Reversed_: Cruelty, perversity,
barbarity, perfidy, evil intention.

upright.summary_zh: 完全满足、喜悦、迅速消息与金钱。
upright.text_en: Perfect contentment, felicity, ecstasy; also speedy intelligence; gold.

reversed.summary_zh: 财富的不利面、不利消息；也可能是大量财富，作者强调物质条件与其益处不同。
reversed.text_en: The evil side of wealth, bad intelligence; also great riches. In any case it shows prosperity, comfortable material conditions, but whether these are of advantage to the possessor will depend on whether the card is reversed or not.

symbolism.summary_zh: 云中之手托起一枚星币。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 关注能够实际改善生活的资源，辨认什么让你感到踏实。
editorial.reversed_zh: 即使资源增加，也检查它是否伴随负担或不合适的交换。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 这份资源真正改善了你的哪一种需要？
editorial.caution_zh: 不保证收入、投资回报或意外之财。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. ACE.

A hand--issuing, as usual, from a cloud--holds up a pentacle.
_Divinatory Meanings_: Perfect contentment, felicity, ecstasy; also
speedy intelligence; gold. _Reversed_: The evil side of wealth, bad
intelligence; also great riches. In any case it shows prosperity,
comfortable material conditions, but whether these are of advantage to
the possessor will depend on whether the card is reversed or not.

upright.summary_zh: 欢乐、消遣；也有书面消息、障碍、动荡和纠葛。
upright.text_en: On the one hand it is represented as a card of gaiety, recreation and its connections, which is the subject of the design; but it is read also as news and messages in writing, as obstacles, agitation, trouble, embroilment.

reversed.summary_zh: 强作欢乐、假装享受、文字、写作和汇票。
reversed.text_en: Enforced gaiety, simulated enjoyment, literal sense, handwriting, composition, letters of exchange.

symbolism.summary_zh: 人物舞动，两枚星币由横八字形绳带连接。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 检查多件事务之间如何周转，给变化留出余量。
editorial.reversed_zh: 如果一直强撑轻松，可以承认压力并重新安排承诺。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 哪一项安排可以调整，让日常不必一直硬撑？
editorial.caution_zh: 平衡多任务是图像启发的项目改写。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. TWO.

A young man, in the act of dancing, has a pentacle in either hand, and
they are joined by that endless cord which is like the number 8
reversed. _Divinatory Meanings_: On the one hand it is represented as a
card of gaiety, recreation and its connections, which is the subject of
the design; but it is read also as news and messages in writing, as
obstacles, agitation, trouble, embroilment. _Reversed_: Enforced gaiety,
simulated enjoyment, literal sense, handwriting, composition, letters of
exchange.

upright.summary_zh: 职业、技艺、熟练劳动；也有声誉与荣耀。
upright.text_en: _Métier_, trade, skilled labor; usually, however, regarded as a card of nobility, aristocracy, renown, glory.

reversed.summary_zh: 平庸、幼稚、琐碎与薄弱。
reversed.text_en: Mediocrity, in work and otherwise, puerility, pettiness, weakness.

symbolism.summary_zh: 工匠在修道院中工作，作者将其与星币八作比较。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 明确成果的质量标准，用专业技能和反馈推动工作。
editorial.reversed_zh: 找到具体欠缺的环节，安排练习或协作，而非笼统否定能力。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 做好这件事，需要补足哪一项技能或反馈？
editorial.caution_zh: 团队合作是项目延伸，不应只据此推断具体同事态度。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. THREE.

A sculptor at his work in a monastery. Compare the design which
illustrates the Eight of Pentacles. The apprentice or amateur therein
has received his reward and is now at work in earnest. _Divinatory
Meanings_: _Métier_, trade, skilled labor; usually, however, regarded as
a card of nobility, aristocracy, renown, glory. _Reversed_: Mediocrity,
in work and otherwise, puerility, pettiness, weakness.

upright.summary_zh: 财产的稳固、守住已有之物、赠与、遗产和继承。
upright.text_en: The surety of possessions, cleaving to that which one has, gift, legacy, inheritance.

reversed.summary_zh: 悬而未决、延迟与阻力。
reversed.text_en: Suspense, delay, opposition

symbolism.summary_zh: 人物抱住星币，头顶和脚下也各有星币。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 思考保留资源带来的安全感，也看看紧抓不放的成本。
editorial.reversed_zh: 面对拖延或阻力，先评估可动用的余量，不急着作不可逆决定。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你需要保留多少，才会觉得安全？
editorial.caution_zh: 此来源逆位不自动代表慷慨或放手。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. FOUR.

A crowned figure, having a pentacle over his crown, clasps another with
hands and arms; two pentacles are under his feet. He holds to that which
he has. _Divinatory Meanings_: The surety of possessions, cleaving to
that which one has, gift, legacy, inheritance. _Reversed_: Suspense,
delay, opposition

upright.summary_zh: 主要为物质困难；另有爱情、伴侣与和谐的相反解释。
upright.text_en: The card foretells material trouble above all, whether in the form illustrated--that is, destitution--or otherwise. For some cartomancists, it is a card of love and lovers--wife, husband, friend, mistress; also concordance, affinities. These alternatives cannot be harmonized.

reversed.summary_zh: 失序、混乱、毁损、不和与挥霍。
reversed.text_en: Disorder, chaos, ruin, discord, profligacy.

symbolism.summary_zh: 两位贫困者在风雪中经过亮着灯的窗。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 辨认现实中缺少的资源，并寻找能够获得的具体支持。
editorial.reversed_zh: 先稳定基本安排，减少进一步消耗，逐项处理混乱。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 哪一种实际帮助现在最有用？
editorial.caution_zh: 不能预告贫穷；不得把困境归咎为用户的命运或品德。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. FIVE.

Two mendicants in a snowstorm pass a lighted casement. _Divinatory
Meanings_: The card foretells material trouble above all, whether in the
form illustrated--that is, destitution--or otherwise. For some
cartomancists, it is a card of love and lovers--wife, husband, friend,
mistress; also concordance, affinities. These alternatives cannot be
harmonized. _Reversed_: Disorder, chaos, ruin, discord, profligacy.

upright.summary_zh: 礼物、赠与、满足；另有关注、警觉和当下繁荣。
upright.text_en: Presents, gifts, gratification; another account says attention, vigilance; now is the accepted time, present prosperity, etc.

reversed.summary_zh: 欲望、贪求、嫉妒与幻象。
reversed.text_en: Desire, cupidity, envy, jealousy, illusion.

symbolism.summary_zh: 商人称量钱币，向有需要的人分发。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 同时看见给予与接受，明确帮助的方式和双方边界。
editorial.reversed_zh: 检查交换是否夹带比较或过多期待，把条件说清楚。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 这份帮助对双方来说都自愿且清楚吗？
editorial.caution_zh: 不能由牌断定施助者别有用心。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. SIX.

A person in the guise of a merchant weighs money in a pair of scales and
distributes it to the needy and distressed. It is a testimony to his own
success in life, as well as his goodness of heart. _Divinatory
Meanings_: Presents, gifts, gratification; another account says
attention, vigilance; now is the accepted time, present prosperity, etc.
_Reversed_: Desire, cupidity, envy, jealousy, illusion.

upright.summary_zh: 金钱、经营、交换；也有争吵、天真、巧思和净化等分歧。
upright.text_en: These are exceedingly contradictory; in the main, it is a card of money, business, barter; but one reading gives altercation, quarrel--and another innocence, ingenuity, purgation.

reversed.summary_zh: 对拟借出款项的忧虑。
reversed.text_en: Cause for anxiety regarding money which it may be proposed to lend.

symbolism.summary_zh: 年轻人倚杖看着植物上的星币。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 回看投入与收获，决定继续、调整还是停止，而非只因已经投入就坚持。
editorial.reversed_zh: 涉及资源交付时先核实条件，承认自己尚未放心的地方。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 继续投入之前，你希望看到什么证据？
editorial.caution_zh: 评估与耐心是意象延伸；不提供借贷或投资结论。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. SEVEN.

A young man, leaning on his staff, looks intently at seven pentacles
attached to a clump of greenery on his right; one would say that these
were his treasures and that his heart was there. _Divinatory Meanings_:
These are exceedingly contradictory; in the main, it is a card of money,
business, barter; but one reading gives altercation, quarrel--and
another innocence, ingenuity, purgation. _Reversed_: Cause for anxiety
regarding money which it may be proposed to lend.

upright.summary_zh: 工作、雇佣、委托、工艺、技能，可能仍在准备阶段。
upright.text_en: Work, employment, commission, craftsmanship, skill in craft and business, perhaps in the preparatory stage.

reversed.summary_zh: 落空的野心、虚荣、贪求、苛取；也有把技能用于算计。
reversed.text_en: Voided ambition, vanity, cupidity, exaction, usury. It may also signify the possession of skill, in the sense of the ingenious mind turned to cunning and intrigue.

symbolism.summary_zh: 工匠专心制作并展示自己的作品。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 把目标拆成可练习的步骤，用反馈逐渐提高质量。
editorial.reversed_zh: 检查追求成果是否挤掉了学习本身，或让技巧服务于不合适的目的。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你今天可以认真练好哪一个小环节？
editorial.caution_zh: 不要默认逆位只是懒惰。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. EIGHT.

An artist in stone at his work, which he exhibits in the form of
trophies. _Divinatory Meanings_: Work, employment, commission,
craftsmanship, skill in craft and business, perhaps in the preparatory
stage. _Reversed_: Voided ambition, vanity, cupidity, exaction, usury.
It may also signify the possession of skill, in the sense of the
ingenious mind turned to cunning and intrigue.

upright.summary_zh: 谨慎、安全、成功、成就、确定与辨别力。
upright.text_en: Prudence, safety, success, accomplishment, certitude, discernment.

reversed.summary_zh: 欺骗、失信和计划落空。
reversed.text_en: Roguery, deception, voided project, bad faith.

symbolism.summary_zh: 人物立于丰盛葡萄园中，手腕上有鸟。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 认可长期积累带来的成果，并保护让自己安心的日常条件。
editorial.reversed_zh: 再核对成果或承诺背后的事实，避免把漂亮外观等同可靠。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 哪些成果来自你持续而具体的投入？
editorial.caution_zh: 不能凭牌判断某项资产或交易可靠。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. NINE.

A woman, with a bird upon her wrist, stands amidst a great abundance of
grape-vines in the garden of a manorial house. It is a wide domain,
suggesting plenty in all things. Possibly it is her own possession and
testifies to material well-being. _Divinatory Meanings_: Prudence,
safety, success, accomplishment, certitude, discernment. _Reversed_:
Roguery, deception, voided project, bad faith.

upright.summary_zh: 收益、财富、家族事务、档案、血统与家宅。
upright.text_en: Gain, riches; family matters, archives, extraction, the abode of a family.

reversed.summary_zh: 偶然、宿命、损失、盗窃、赌博；另有赠礼、嫁资、养老金。
reversed.text_en: Chance, fatality, loss, robbery, games of hazard; sometimes gift, dowry, pension.

symbolism.summary_zh: 住宅拱门前有不同年龄的人物和狗。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 考虑资源如何支持长期生活，以及家庭或群体中的责任如何分配。
editorial.reversed_zh: 检视共同资源的约定与不确定性，避免用想当然替代沟通。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你希望保留下来的，是财富、关系还是某种生活方式？
editorial.caution_zh: 不预测继承或家庭财富，不把原文分支合成确定结论。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. TEN.

A man and woman beneath an archway which gives entrance to a house and
domain. They are accompanied by a child, who looks curiously at two dogs
accosting an ancient personage seated in the foreground. The child's
hand is on one of them. _Divinatory Meanings_: Gain, riches; family
matters, archives, extraction, the abode of a family. _Reversed_:
Chance, fatality, loss, robbery, games of hazard; sometimes gift, dowry,
pension.

upright.summary_zh: 应用、学习、学问、反思；也有消息、规则和管理。
upright.text_en: Application, study, scholarship, reflection; another reading says news, messages and the bringer thereof; also rule, management.

reversed.summary_zh: 挥霍、放纵、慷慨、奢侈与不利消息。
reversed.text_en: Prodigality, dissipation, liberality, luxury, unfavorable news.

symbolism.summary_zh: 年轻人物专注凝视举起的星币，缓慢前行。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 给学习或新任务一个具体安排，把兴趣变成可积累的实践。
editorial.reversed_zh: 检查时间与资源的使用，减少脱离目标的消耗。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你愿意持续练习的一项基础能力是什么？
editorial.caution_zh: 不保证录取、考试或职业机会。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. PAGE.

A youthful figure, looking intently at the pentacle which hovers over
his raised hands. He moves slowly, insensible of that which is about
him. _Divinatory Meanings_: Application, study, scholarship, reflection;
another reading says news, messages and the bringer thereof; also rule,
management. _Reversed_: Prodigality, dissipation, liberality, luxury,
unfavorable news.

upright.summary_zh: 实用、服务、利益、责任与正直。
upright.text_en: Utility, serviceableness, interest, responsibility, rectitude--all on the normal and external plane.

reversed.summary_zh: 惯性、闲散、停滞、平静、泄气与粗心。
reversed.text_en: Inertia, idleness, repose of that kind, stagnation; also placidity, discouragement, carelessness.

symbolism.summary_zh: 骑者坐在缓慢而耐久的马上，展示星币。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 用稳定的节奏履行承诺，重视可重复的实际行动。
editorial.reversed_zh: 区分休息与停滞，找一个足够小的动作恢复推进。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 什么样的节奏能让你真正坚持下去？
editorial.caution_zh: 逆位不必一律批评为懒惰。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. KNIGHT.

He rides a slow, enduring, heavy horse, to which his own aspect
corresponds. He exhibits his symbol, but does not look therein.
_Divinatory Meanings_: Utility, serviceableness, interest,
responsibility, rectitude--all on the normal and external plane.
_Reversed_: Inertia, idleness, repose of that kind, stagnation; also
placidity, discouragement, carelessness.

upright.summary_zh: 富足、慷慨、宏大、安稳与自由。
upright.text_en: Opulence, generosity, magnificence, security, liberty.

reversed.summary_zh: 疑虑、悬而未决、恐惧、不信任及不善等旧式词条。
reversed.text_en: Evil, suspicion, suspense, fear, mistrust.

symbolism.summary_zh: 王后凝望星币，作者强调宽厚与认真的智慧。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 把照料落实到日常资源和舒适条件，同时保留自己的自由。
editorial.reversed_zh: 如果安全感不足，先检查实际条件，再讨论担忧。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 什么具体安排能让你今天更踏实一些？
editorial.caution_zh: 不把物质照料限定为女性职责。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
PENTACLES. QUEEN.

The face suggests that of a dark woman, whose qualities might be summed
up in the idea of greatness of soul; she has also the serious cast of
intelligence; she contemplates her symbol and may see worlds therein.
_Divinatory Meanings_: Opulence, generosity, magnificence, security,
liberty. _Reversed_: Evil, suspicion, suspense, fear, mistrust.

upright.summary_zh: 勇气、智慧、经营、数学才能及这些领域的成功。
upright.text_en: Valor, intelligence, business, mathematical gifts, and success in these paths.

reversed.summary_zh: 恶习、软弱、乖戾与危险。
reversed.text_en: Vice, weakness, perversity, peril.

symbolism.summary_zh: 国王宝座有牛头图案，持星币。

historical.note: 历史资料记录，不作为事实预测；中文为有选择的摘要，完整依据见英文片段。

editorial.upright_zh: 稳妥运用已有能力与资源，让成果服务于长期责任。
editorial.reversed_zh: 检查资源管理中的薄弱处，用记录和反馈替代单凭自信。
editorial.reflection_question_zh: 你愿意怎样证明自己的管理方式可靠？
editorial.caution_zh: 不保证财富增长，也不把现实人物按牌定性。
editorial.attribution_label: 卜犀反思式改写（AI 编辑初稿）；参考 Waite 相关历史文本，非作者原话。

meaning.text_en:
THE SUIT OF PENTACLES. KING.

The face of this figure is dark, suggesting courage, and the bull's head
should be noted as a recurrent symbol on the throne. The sign of this
suit is represented throughout as engraved with the pentigram, typifying
the correspondence of the four elements in human nature and that by
which they may be governed. In old Tarot packs this suit represented
money. The consensus of divinatory meanings is on the side of change, as
the cards do not deal especially with questions of money. _Divinatory
Meanings_: Valor, intelligence, business, mathematical gifts, and
success in these paths. _Reversed_: Vice, weakness, perversity, peril.
